defect: the GUI/sidebar raised `cannot resolve target "<cwd>/team-activity": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath '<cwd>/team-activity'` when the AgentTeams tab auto-opened
reported: user-reported live GUI error (web profile; DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 CLI + rc.2 packages; dsh-better-sidebar 0.19.0-alpha.1)
rootCause: packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/team-page.js auto-opened the tab WITH a content seed (`openTab({ type, path: "team-activity" })`). dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19 routes any seed carrying `path`/`url` to DSH's NATIVE right column instead of the registered tab type, so the host resolved <cwd>/team-activity through path-security, failed realpath and threw - while the tab never opened at all.

dispatchRule.code: if (seed.path !== void 0) surface.openResource({ sessionId, address: surface.fileAddress(targetSessionId, scope?.cwd, seed.path), revealIfOpened: true })

vendorEvidence.doc: OpenTabSeed.target: 'right' (default) = DSH's right Sidebar; a `path`/`url` seed goes through the native surface instead of the registered tab type

fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/team-page: drop AUTO_OPEN_SEED_PATH; open seedless: `openTab({ type: TEAM_TAB_ID })` (a type-only open lands the tab in its own surface and expands it)
fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/client.js: rebuilt with `node scripts/build-mpd-client.mjs` and re-packed into dist/mpd-package
fix.packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/test/team-pag: the auto-open test asserted a STRING seed.path (the old contract); it now asserts the seed is exactly { type: 'mpd-agent-teams' }
fix.skills/dsh-qa/scripts/agent-teams-sideba: new `seedlessAutoOpen` check on the shipped AND the served bytes

falsifiability: re-injecting `path: AUTO_OPEN_SEED_PATH` into the built client makes `agent-teams-sidebar --self-test` fail on seedlessAutoOpen (measured; reverted by rebuilding).
